Feel free to choose your desired room amount, seed and session options. Explore the complex or hide from the entity.

PC CONTROLS:
H to show controls
X to unlock mouse cursor
F to toggle flashlight on/off
G to whistle
Hold LeftShift to run
Ctrl to crouch/uncrouch
RightMouse to grab/drop objects
V to toggle fly mode (if enabled)
C to toggle detailed info
Z to toggle the debug console (if enabled)

Shift + press a number = select all units of the same type

MOBILE

games.name: Guess The Sequence!
games.description:
🧠 Can you decode the sequence before your opponent does? Welcome to Guess The Sequence, the ultimate 1v1 multiplayer puzzle game of logic, strategy, and chaos!

⚔️ HOW TO PLAY:
1. CREATE your own secret sequence of blocks.
2. SWAP sequences with your opponent.
3. DEDUCE and guess their code using logic!
4. USE powerful hints or unleash chaotic SABOTAGES to swap their blocks mid-game and scramble their progress!

🌟 GAME FEATURES:
🧠 DEDUCTION DUELS - Go head-to-head in turn-based logic battles!
⚡ SABOTAGES - Scramble your opponent's board by swapping two blocks in their target sequence!
💡 HINTS - Stuck on a guess? Get a quick hint to reveal a block!
🤖 SOLO PRACTICE MODE - Play offline against AI Bots!
🎨 CUSTOMIZE YOUR BLOCKS - Earn Gold & Trophies to unlock Neon, Emojis, Numbers, and Minecraft-themed block packs in the Shop! and more to come!
